reason: A streamer may try the browser trainer on 2026-09-25; showiness matters more than raw strength as long as the player is strong enough. Two shaped candidates are trained overnight instead of the queued arm (b)/(a) pair.

bigclear-champ.parent: champion-retention-mixed-v2 (core-final-inference.pt, G5, deployable in the browser as is)

bigclear-armA.parent: armA-ppo-v1-f00100000000 (as pre-registered; f50M and f100M rate level, f100M kept for continuity with the baseline benchmark)

bonus.why: stepped so T3 dominates (0.05/0.15/0.30 per clear), game cap 0.60 so one or two T3 clears are not capped away (30% of the win/loss swing). Parents' natural tier bonus at these bars: 0.009/game (arm A f100M) and 0.022/game (champion), pool traces. Horizontal: completed horizontal lines only (no reward for unclearing horizontal placements), 0.004 per clear plus 0.008 when the clear is a combo (2+ lines), own cap 0.10/game; parents clear 7-8 horizontal per game (~0.03-0.04/game), so the cap is not reached at baseline; per event a T2 is worth 12-37 horizontal clears. Note: the requested 0.02-0.04 per horizontal clear would pay ~0.2/game at baseline and swamp the tiers, and 'well under the T2/T3 bonus per game' is impossible at any useful size because big clears are rare, so the horizontal bonus is sized well under the tiers per event instead.

curriculum.sizing: level-14 learner decisions per game: natural 53.6, stranded bank 18.3 (A+S journal), showiness bank ~0.65x natural (smoke); expected ~19% / ~14% / ~67% incl. level-20 collections
curriculum.why: constant shares: the stranded-edge variant's decaying share reached only ~2% of frames and had no effect. Logged per update: start_mix_update_decision_fraction (all banks) and start_mix_update_decision_fraction_by_bank (0 showiness, 1 stranded edge).

changes.not_used: coalesce_inference (no validated tf3090 smoke on record)

step_size.why: arm A clips every step and its update KL is ~0.0015 against a 0.03 cap; style fine-tunes need the policy to move. After each update lr *= clip(sqrt(0.005/update_kl), 0.5, 1.5), halved if update_kl > 0.015. max_update_kl 0.03, parent-KL and retention guards unchanged. Start raised to 2e-5 with the 2048-row steps.

retention_hinge.loss: coefficient x pressure_p x relu(KL_p(minibatch) - KL_p(start)) averaged over paces
retention_hinge.start: per-pace KL to the anchor-bank teacher distributions (not the parent) measured over the whole bank at initialisation; nonzero for both candidates
retention_hinge.why: training diagnostics (analysis/training-diagnostics 3821a7f9, 874e4dac): retention was ~0.67x the policy signal and pulled against it at several paces, distilling below its start at Relaxed and Normal; the hinge keeps the drift bound (coefficient 0.1, max_anchor_kl_increase 0.03, pressure 31 unchanged) but drops the pull back toward the teachers

minibatch.how: minibatch 128 x accumulate_minibatches 16 (row-weighted gradient mean, one optimizer step per group); per-step GPU memory unchanged, 2 epochs
minibatch.why: diagnostics: ~6% of a 128-row minibatch gradient is signal, gradient noise scale ~3.5e5 decisions
minibatch.grad_clip: 0.7 kept; pre-clip norm and the clipped fraction are logged per update (gradient.pre_clip_norm, gradient.clipped_fraction) to judge whether it should scale

strength_rule: Strong enough for the showcase: the pooled l14-spawn rating stays within 60 Elo of the champion (point estimate >= 1440 with the champion anchored at 1500). This replaces the -15 Elo guard for these two candidates only; the style trade-off report is unchanged.
reporting: per snapshot: pooled Elo vs the champion; T1_20 (old), T1, T2, T3 per 100 placements; horizontal clears per 100 and horizontal share of clears; best clear; ASCII boards of the largest clears. Per update: update_kl, adaptive lr, bank decision fraction, bonus fire rate, learner style (natural games). Stranded edge: the stranded-edge benchmark as A+S was evaluated (tools/eval_stranded_edge solo, paired restricted-mean pills to clear the stranded virus on strata 0-1, frame_perfect + normal, plus target_cleared and support-destroying clears), each snapshot vs its parent.
pool: runs bigclear-champ and bigclear-armA, era style:big-combo, parents as above; intention big-clear-setups (entrants bigclear-*)

tiers.why: user focus on T2+/T3; T1 raised to the integer bar where the human corpus rate is ~0.3 per 100 placements: >=26.5 gives 0.301, >=27 gives 0.275, >=26 gives 0.327 (20.2M clears over 57.3M placements); old T1 (>=20, 0.85 per 100) still reported

horizontal_baseline.definition: a clear counts as horizontal if any matched line in any round is horizontal (4+ in a row)

logging_per_update: style_update (T1_20/T1/T2/T3/horizontal per 100, horizontal_share, best; natural games)
nature: A deliberately combined showcase recipe (showiness curriculum + stepped bonus + horizontal bonus + stranded-edge curriculum + retention hinge + 2048-row steps + KL-targeted lr), trained for a streamer demo. It is NOT a controlled test of any single change; its snapshots are compared with their parents only as whole recipes.
